title: Does Johnny Get the Message? Evaluating Cybersecurity Notifications for Everyday Users
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and applying an evaluation framework (HCSAEF) for cybersecurity notifications generated by LLMs. Its evaluation dimensions (consequences, context, countermeasures, correctness, intuitiveness, personalization, and urgency) and case studies are centered on technical clarity and user understanding rather than religion, morals, or ethics.
